entities.name: The Ten Commandments (Decalogue)
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The ten foundational moral and religious laws given by God to Moses at Sinai (Exodus 20, Deuteronomy 5). Covering duties to God (no other gods, no idols, Sabbath) and duties to neighbor (no murder, theft, false witness, coveting). The bedrock of Western legal and ethical tradition.
